biotools.summary: COSGAP provides containerized statistical genetics analysis pipelines, facilitating reproducible and standardized genetic data analysis across diverse environments. It utilizes established software tools packaged into Singularity containers with helper scripts for tasks such as genome-wide association studies and gene-set enrichment analysis.
